doctrine: Claude Cowork is a desktop AI agent (runs on user's computer, not cloud) that autonomously executes multi-step workflows with direct read/write access to local files and external apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Airtable, Zapier MCP for 9000+ apps). Core operating model: (1) Setup phase: dedicated folder structure (context/projects/output), markdown context files (about_me.md, brand_voice.md, working_preferences.md), global instructions in settings; (2) Task execution: outcome-first prompting (define end state, not steps), auto-generates task plan with parallel sub-agents; (3) Memory layer: persistent .md files capture preferences, past decisions, writing styles, inbox rules; (4) Skills: reusable playbooks created via skill_creator meta-skill, require brand voice reference, updatable via feedback loop; (5) Connectors: integrate Gmail, Drive, Slack, Calendar, Notion, Airtable, custom MCP servers; (6) Scheduled tasks: run on user's machine (limitation: computer must stay on), run at specified time daily/weekly/custom; (7) Dispatch: mobile control of desktop tasks via Claude mobile app. Routing rule: task-first language (outcome, constraints, quality bar) not step-first. Project-level memory > chat-level memory due to local file persistence. Plugins = bundled skills + connectors. Extends to Claude Code (desktop terminal IDE, runs on Anthropic servers, routines work offline, multiple sessions parallel, local + remote execution) and Chat (no file access, 20-file limit, copy-paste workflow).
skills: skill_creator (meta-skill for building custom skills with eval rubrics)
inbox_triage (Gmail + Calendar integration for daily briefing)
content_creation (social media drafting with brand voice reference)
video_generation (Python-based local animation or Blotato integration)
gates: Always read associated context files (claude.md, memory.md) at task start
Brand voice document must be loaded before content creation
Feedback loop required for skill improvement (eval rubrics test against scoring rubric)
Parallel sub-agent batches capped at 10-15 leads/tasks per sub-agent to avoid token bloat
Local file access requires explicit folder selection and always-allow permission
Scheduled tasks depend on computer + app running (not cloud-based)
Pre-built plugins are read-only; duplicate to customize
Preferences update requires explicit save to claude.md or memory.md
Web search unreliable; avoid forcing it mid-conversation (falls back to unreliable browser extension)
workflows: Content creation pipeline: brand_voice_interview → skill_creation → content_drafting → image_sourcing (local or AI) → Blotato_publishing → schedule_management
Email productivity: Gmail_connection → inbox_triage_skill → daily_briefing_MD → draft_replies → persistent_memory_update
Lead generation: CSV_upload → parallel_lead_qualification_agents (batch 5-15 per agent) → parallel_enrichment_agents (LinkedIn scraping) → consolidated_CSV_output → outbound_enrichment_command
Scheduled daily briefing: 6am trigger → Gmail_scan + Calendar_scan + Obsidian_vault_read → markdown_report_generation → Slack_post (optional)
Video/infographic batch: markdown_content_brief → Python_animation OR Blotato_template_selection → visual_generation (30-60 sec wait) → social_media_post_with_attachment → calendar_scheduling
Skill improvement loop: execute_task → gather_feedback → skill_creator_eval → update_skill.md → re-test → overwrite_old_version
prompts: Interview me until you're 95% confident you can write content in my brand voice
Organize [folder] by [type/date/topic]; verify blurry items; flag unclear entries
Process [meeting transcripts] by extracting action items, owners, deadlines; write follow-up email under 150 words
Create a skill for [task description] with test cases and eval rubric
Search [platform] for [topic] from past [time period]; identify content gaps; suggest which fits my channel based on [about_me.md]
Go through my emails from past month; extract tone of voice and writing style principles; save as memory_MD
Scrape [YouTube/Reddit/Poly Market/web] for [query]; generate 10 viral content ideas with hooks, angles, platforms
Schedule this post to next free slot [platform] with relevant caption
Turn this workflow into a repeatable skill using skill_creator; set up eval rubric for scoring consistency
Enrich [CSV with leads]; spin up parallel sub-agents (max 15 per agent); add LinkedIn posts, company descriptions, company size
Create a plugin called [name] with [skill1], [skill2], [command] combining them in sequence
Reschedule all remaining posts 2 days later and confirm IDs
operating_rules: Outcome-first language: define end result and constraints, not step-by-step instructions
Setup is non-negotiable: 5min folder structure + context files save hours per week
One project per recurring workflow (client deliverables, content production, admin/finance, weekly reporting)
Projects accumulate context over time; more runs = better alignment
Persistent memory via local .md files (CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md) > cloud-based memory (hard limit)
Parallel sub-agents for batch work (max 15 leads per agent to avoid token bloat)
Skills are updatable; continuously refine via feedback loop (takes 30 min to 1 hour per skill with skill_creator)
Brand voice is load-bearing: every content skill must reference it
Connectors enable autonomy: Gmail + Calendar + Drive + Notion create the minimal viable integration stack
Scheduled tasks require computer ON + Claude app open (not cloud-based like Routines in Code 2.0)
Plugins are shareable .zip files or GitHub-versioned; good for team/community distribution
Web search unreliable in Cowork; prefer explicit connector + local files for context
Browser extension slow, unreliable, token-expensive; avoid when possible
Dispatch enables mobile control but tasks still run on desktop (not truly remote)
Test skills manually before scheduling them
Feedback refinement essential: skills without feedback loops remain generic
File naming and structure matter: descriptive names enable cross-session discovery
Always allow vs allow-once: start conservative (allow-once) until pattern repeats, then always-allow

The psychology of setup: why 5 minutes of folder structure saves 50 hours
Skill creator deep-dive: building production-grade reusable AI workflows with eval rubrics
Persistent memory architecture: CLAUDE.md + MEMORY.md as the brain of autonomous agents
Batch processing at scale: parallel sub-agents for lead enrichment, customer data extraction, document review

Content calendar automation: from drafting to scheduling without touching 5 different tools
Prompt template library: outcome-first language patterns for different task types

Obsidian + Cowork integration: building a persistent second brain for context recall
Blotato plugin ecosystem: automated social media publishing with visual asset generation
The skill improvement loop: turning ad-hoc work into repeatable playbooks
Multi-connector workflows: Gmail + Calendar + Notion cross-reference for meeting automation
Sub-agent orchestration: spinning up 10 parallel agents for 100 leads without token explosion
contradictions: Scheduled tasks run locally (must keep computer on) vs Routines in Claude Code run on Anthropic servers (no device requirement) - different products, not a contradiction, but confusing for users upgrading
Pre-built plugins read-only vs need customization - intentional, but creates friction (must duplicate then edit)
Web search capability exists but unreliable due to browser extension dependency - feature is present but practically disabled
Local file access is powerful but creates permission friction vs cloud-based tools (Notion, Airtable) which auto-sync - tradeoff, not contradiction
Outcome-first prompting best practice vs users still defaulting to task-first language from Chat experience - user behavior lag, not doc contradiction
weird_gold: Sub-agents can spawn in parallel, meaning you can batch 100 leads across 10 agents simultaneously without token explosion (key unlock for enterprise workflows)
Brand voice as a required reference in every skill MD = enforced consistency without manual review (architecture-level quality gate)
.md file persistence + automatic claude.md/memory.md reading at session start = context survives conversation resets (unlike Chat)
Skill creator's eval rubric system = AI evaluating AI output quality with scoring, enabling skill version control (not just prompt versioning)
Outcome-first language (what should the end state be?) reduces hallucination vs task-first (tell me every step)
Dispatch (mobile control) works because tasks run on desktop, not cloud (unlike cloud-first competitors)
Plugins as .zip + GitHub = offline-friendly skill distribution without cloud lock-in
Connectors can be chained (Gmail + Notion in same task) creating mini-workflows without coding
Parallel sub-agents with batched inputs = DX innovation (most AI tools handle one task at a time)
Skill duplication workflow = library management for non-devs (copy-paste + customize, no git required)
